description: Comune di Cursi publishes a census and map of municipal properties described as available. Its 37 declared fields include property identifiers and type, address, latitude/longitude, cadastral references, area, cubic volume, construction period, use and ownership share. These are source-declared fields for an asset register; individual values were not inspected. The property-type composition is unknown, so the resource is not described as an exclusively residential or building-only inventory. Coverage is the named municipality in Puglia, Italy. Observation dates, present availability, the population of coordinate fields and positional accuracy remain unverified. Native metadata lists a CSV distribution under the CC BY 4.0 licence. The metadata and table schema are public; charges and access conditions for later file use are not established. No specific simulation application is documented. Related municipal property registers use similar field structures but represent different publishers and inventories. No CSV rows, maps or feature collections were read.
